items.text: All 3 workshop decisions from round-001 were incorporated into plan.md: (d1) provenance threading via StageInput.Provenance, (d2) git_commit_hash included in all artifact JSON responses, (d3) GitCommitHash added to UploadRequest struct. The Contract Decisions table in section 8 now explicitly references each confirmed choice.

Implementation Strategy (section 7) was tightened: Phase 2 steps now explicitly name UploadRequest as the carrier struct and StageInput.Provenance as the source, removing the prior ambiguity ('UploadRequest or deploy flow'). Phase 1 step 5 now explicitly includes ON CONFLICT UPDATE SET for the new column.
Definition of Done (section 13) updated to include response visibility ('git_commit_hash appears in all artifact JSON responses') and the UploadRequest threading path.

Readiness upgraded to 3/3 across all dimensions. Testable moved from 2→3 (round-trip test strategy is concrete and covers both positive and backward-compat cases). Risk awareness moved from 2→3 (scan target ordering risk is explicitly called out in both risks table and implementation steps). No remaining gaps — plan is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated 3 confirmed workshop decisions into Contract Decisions table. Tightened Phase 2 implementation steps to remove ambiguity. Updated Definition of Done to reflect confirmed API response and threading choices. All readiness dimensions now at 3/3.
